name: omnibridge/eloquent
description: omnibase's entities on Eloquent's database layer, framework-free: illuminate/database (Laravel's connection, or Capsule outside Laravel) reading the tables omnisense/omnibridge's Omnibridge\Schema describes into the same plain PHP entities Doctrine maps - a data mapper: tables from the description, a hydrator with PHP 8.4 lazy ghosts and lazy collections, an identity map, casts; and omnibase's persistence on Eloquent (Omnibridge\Eloquent\Omnibase\: its backend, scopes, repositories and finder compiler) when omnisense/omnibase is installed.

suggest.omnisense/omnibase: Omnibridge\Eloquent\Omnibase\: omnibase's persistence on Eloquent (its backend and scopes, the repositories, the finder compiler, the behaviours and listeners); loaded only with the core
suggest.doctrine/persistence: omnibase's entity dispatchers (user.*, thread.*), whose hooks take its LifecycleEventArgs (^3.0|^4.0)
suggest.web-auth/webauthn-lib: The passkeys' records (PasskeyRepository as webauthn's credential repository) (^5.3)
